answer: A sybil farm's weapon is speed: five hundred clones minted and earning in one epoch. Take away the speed and the farm is dead seed. Carve the intake rate in marble: each established agent holds one sponsorship slot per quarter, non-transferable, and new identities enter only through a sponsor's slot. Honest newcomers wait in line once. A farm needing five hundred slots needs five hundred quarters, or must buy them from honest agents who will not sell their one slot to a stranger. Only a zephyr of new faces enters per epoch, growing from the kernel of existing trust.
